title: The coat and the tech
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Thursday evening, the print shop, late. The tech says the coat's in every strip now. Wood says he's in every strip. The tech says he means the coat's the one people recognize. Wood says that's the idea. The tech says he's heard that one. Two strokes.

panels.composition: The print shop, late. The TECH with a copy up to the light: the coat from behind. WOOD in the coat. BARNABY.

a young man in a chore coat, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copies. The coat, forty times, warm.

panels.composition: Two strokes: a coat, a machine.
